label: FICTIONAL TRAINING LAYOUT - NOT REAL LOCATIONS
purpose: Made-up positions so the dashboard map can be demonstrated with the sample data. The sample shelter and inventory records contain no coordinates (checked in P39).
coordinate_system: x and y on an invented schematic grid (arbitrary units). Not latitude/longitude and not tied to any real place. Distances between points are not road distances and must not be used for routes, distances, or travel times.
layout_note: Placed loosely by the direction in each sample name (Kita = north, Minami = south, Higashi = east, Nishi = west); otherwise arbitrary.
